name: KK Oph

paper.title: Planet-forming disks and their environment across regions and time from the full NIR census

notes: SPHERE/IRDIS H-band polarimetric image (program 0111.C-0369, PI Vioque). A very inclined disk with a P.A. of 70 deg is visible; a bright companion is detected 1.6 arcsec SW of the star from the intensity image (Garufi et al. 2026). No SIMBAD parallax; dist_pc from the paper's 0.5-arcsec scale bar (83 au).
